list_entry.short_description: The feature is part of a billboard.
The feature is supported by a ceiling.
The feature is supported by a column. A column is a large round support, made of stone, with a capital and a base.

The feature is directly put on the ground.
The feature is supported by a mast.
The feature is supported by a pedestal.

The feature is supported by a scaffold.

The feature is supported by a cable/wire stretched between two attachment points.
